title: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Third Amendment Ordinance 1996

sections.shortTitle: Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Third Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short, title and commencement

ORDINANCE CIV OF 1996
ORDINANCE CIV OF 1996
PAKISTAN WATER AND POWER DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
(THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An ordinance further to amend the Pakistan
Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub.,
dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 (W.P. Act XXXI of 1958),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred
by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short, title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority (Second Amendment)
Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 3, W.P. Act XXXI of 1958

(THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An ordinance further to amend the Pakistan
Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958

2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub.,
dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 (W.P. Act XXXI of 1958),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred
by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 3, W.P. Act XXXI of
1958.‑‑(1)
In the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 (W.P. Act XXXI
of 1958), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 3, after
subsection (2) the following new subsection shall be added, namely:‑‑‑
"(3) The Federal Government may, from time
to time, issue such directives as it may consider necessary on matters of
policy and the Authority shall comply with such directives; and if a question
arises whether any directive relates to a matter of policy, the decision of the
Federal Government shall be final. ".

Substitution of section 4, W.P. Act XXXI of 1958

An ordinance further to amend the Pakistan

No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub.,
dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑The following Ordinance made by the
President is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority Act, 1958 (W.P. Act XXXI of 1958),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is not in
session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred
by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:‑‑
3. Substitution of section 4, W.P. Act XXXI of
1958.‑‑In
the said Act, for section 4, the following shall be substituted:
"4. Appointment and terms of office of
Chairman and Members.‑‑(1) The Authority shall consist of the
Chairman and six Members to be appointed by the Government, namely:‑
(i) The Chairman
(ii) Secretary, Ministry of Finance,
Government of Pakistan ... ... Member
(iii) Secretary, Ministry of Water and
Power, Government of Pakistan ... ... Member
(iv) Secretary, Planning & Development
Division, Government of Pakistan ... ... Member
(v) Three professionals in the field of
engineering, management or finance ... ... Members
(2) The Chairman and Members, other than ex
officio Members, shall hold office for a period of three years:
Provided that the Federal Government may, in
its discretion and in the public interest, terminate the appointment of the
Chairman or any Member at any time before the expiry of such period.
(3) Where any civil servant or an officer or
servant of the Authority appointed as a Chairman or a Member ceases to be the
Chairman or as the case may be, the Member, he will revert to the service to
which he belonged before such appointment. ".
